issues.description: Class method Bitmap24::save has a return-type mismatch in the template repository: in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp (template) the method is declared as 'int save(const std::string &i_filename);' but in example_program/src/Bitmap24.cpp (template) it is defined as 'void Bitmap24::save(const std::string &i_filename)'. The solution repository's header declares the method as 'void save(...)' as well. This declaration/definition mismatch in the template will cause compilation errors and will block students from building the example program.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the declaration and definition consistent. Prefer matching the solution: change the template header declaration to 'void save(const std::string &i_filename);' in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp. Alternatively, modify the implementation to return int and return an appropriate status, but updating the header to void is the simplest fix to match the reference implementation.
